fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2018 by $93.9 million. As of December 31, 2018 and 2017, we did not have any outstanding fuel derivatives and we have not engaged in fuel derivative activity since 2015.

instrument_type_details.notes: Explicitly states no fuel derivative activity since 2015.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 412,256 [2018] 343,709 [2017] [from 2018 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense increased by 52.4% from $616.3 million in 2017 to $939.2 million in 2018 due to 20.0% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
